notes.text: Holds use, supervision and control of the Scientology religious marks and the Advanced Technology (gift from L. Ron Hubbard, May 1982); oversees lower-ranking churches for orthodoxy; churches ministering the Advanced Technology pay RTC six percent of contributions.
Owner of registered trademarks protecting the Advanced Technology; licenses CSI and the Church of Scientology of California to use it.

entities.name: Church Of Scientology International
entities.note: No Form 990 financial data in the IRS extracts indexed by ProPublica.

notes.text: Holds a license from RTC to use the marks with Scientology services, on condition that it recognize RTC as the final word on theological orthodoxy.
Licensed by CST to use Hubbard copyrighted works.

entities.name: Church Of Spiritual Technology
entities.note: No Form 990 financial data in the IRS extracts indexed by ProPublica.

notes.text: Created 1982 to receive the bulk of the Hubbard estate; holds an option, at its sole discretion, to take over the marks assigned to RTC; staff and officers must be Sea Org members.
IRS denial of 501(c)(3) status sustained (1992) and affirmed (1993).
Acquired the copyrights to Hubbard works in 1993 and licenses them to CSI, WISE and other affiliated entities.
Licensee of CST for Hubbard works; licenses members to sell WISE courses.
Co-plaintiff with RTC and CSI; authorized by RTC to use the Advanced Technology.

name: Church of Scientology Flag Service Organization

notes.text: A Sea Org church employing over 900 Sea Org members (per the 1992 opinion).
Unincorporated association through which, per the court, real control is exercised; CSI, RTC, CST and the Flag Service Org are Sea Org churches.
